intuition: A nonnegative number is palindromic when its leading and trailing digits mirror each other.

brute_force.approach: Convert the number to text and compare it with its reversal.

optimal.approach: Reverse only the lower half of the digits and compare the halves.

edge_cases: A nonzero number ending in zero cannot be a palindrome.
Odd-length numbers ignore the middle digit when comparing halves.
